summary: Frontend-only verification of Telegram link change to https://t.me/+uh_mmVGlIZFjM2Ux. Logged in as admin via POST /api/login (200) and checked every anchor with an href containing 't.me' on /, /support, /orders, /deposit, /ranks, /shop, /cards, /redeem and on all four /profile tabs (Overview, Orders, Balance, Settings). Every t.me href found was exactly https://t.me/+uh_mmVGlIZFjM2Ux with target=_blank and rel='noopener noreferrer'. The old links '+3-lMkt-idutkOTIx' and 't.me/yourchannel' do not appear in the rendered HTML of any page, in client/server source, or in a pg_dump of the database. The regression check passed: the /profile Orders empty-state 'Browse Marketplace' button has a light-blue background rgb(96,165,250) with black text rgb(0,0,0), and the app loaded normally.

issues: The Telegram icon-only anchor has no aria-label or data-testid, so screen readers announce no link text. It is also very small (20px).
The parent container uses opacity-50, so the light-blue 'Browse Marketplace' button looks dimmed and washed out. The computed colors themselves are correct.

action_items: Optional: add aria-label='Telegram' and a data-testid to the footer Telegram anchors in SupportPage.tsx and DepositPage.tsx.
Optional: move opacity-50 off the empty-state wrapper in ProfilePage.tsx (~line 484) so the CTA button is shown at full color.
critical_code_review_comments: server/telegram.ts:28 and server/telegram-referrals.ts:7 use TELEGRAM_JOIN_URL with the new URL as the default. No TELEGRAM_JOIN_URL override is set in the env files that were checked.

Bot deep-links (ProfilePage.tsx:270 OmniMarketCCBot?start=link_ and the server referral links) were kept as intended. Not checked in the UI: the Settings tab showed no deep-link during the test, presumably because no link code had been generated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Navigating many pages quickly with networkidle can trigger a Cloudflare 'Verify you are human' challenge on the preview URL. Wait about 60s and use domcontentloaded plus a short wait. Log in via fetch('/api/login') from the page context.
